pattern.rule: In a 'Scientists X and Y would most likely agree that' item, pick the only option stated as a general class of cause or process; every distractor names a specific mechanism, value, identity or timing.
pattern.why: Both graders named the same rule on the same three items. Applied blind by a fresh agent from the cold packet (stems and options only, scratchpad/act-science-regrade/_r8/b12/rule-picks.json): it found exactly these three agree items and picked the key on 3 of 3. R8 drops them; their passages go.
